summary: Read a two-dimensional grid filled with letters, then read one word. Decide whether the word can be traced cell by cell across the grid. Write true when a trace exists and false when it does not. A trace must follow the letters of the word from its first letter to its last letter. Each step enters a touching cell above, below, left, or right, and never moves on a diagonal. During one trace, one cell may contribute at most one time. A step may not leave the grid. Uppercase and lowercase count as different letters.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
